headline: Indian Women’s Cricket Team Captain Reportedly Using Asia Cup Trophy To Level Unsteady Dining Table
body:
The Indian women's cricket team captain has been spotted at a local suburban cafe, utilizing the newly-won Asia Cup trophy as a makeshift shim to stabilize a wobbly laminate table. The trophy, standing at a precarious angle, was reportedly the only object sturdy enough to stop a plate of steaming pav bhaji from sliding into the lap of the team’s vice-captain.

“We looked around for a coaster or a folded newspaper, but the table tilt was quite severe, nearly a three-degree incline,” noted Rajesh Sharma, a café regular who witnessed the incident. “The captain simply said, ‘It’s a trophy, it’s meant to hold things up,’ and slid it right under the table leg. It didn't just balance the table; it actually improved the whole aesthetic of the outdoor seating area.”

When approached for comment, a team spokesperson confirmed that the squad had grown tired of standard glass-front trophy cabinets. “The cabinet was getting too crowded after eight titles, and frankly, the trophy’s base is perfectly calibrated for industrial-grade stability. It’s the most functional piece of sporting equipment we’ve ever brought home,” the spokesperson added, while helping the team slide a second runner-up medal under a chair leg to address a slight floor unevenness.
caption: From record-breaking victories to solving minor architectural inconveniences, the grind never stops. #Cricket #AsiaCup #TeamIndia #TrophyLife (satire)
